items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: So after that, I went back to Kansas City with Thamon Hayes. Anyway, we called ourselves Thamon Hayes and the Kansas City Rockets by then.

ctx.x: They were from Indianapolis, I think. Yeah, most of them...

So after that, I went back to Kansas City with Thamon Hayes. Anyway, we called ourselves Thamon Hayes and the Kansas City Rockets by then. And we took a boat down the Missouri River, down to St. Louis, and came up the Illinois River, up to Galesburg, Illinois. Galesburg or Peoria...? Oh, Peoria. To Peoria. And we docked there for about two or three weeks. Every night we was playing on this boat, you know. We stopped at each town every night and gave a dance right on the boat, the boat ride, you know, on a trip…

We had a swell arranger in that band, too, named Jesse Stone. Oh, Jesse Stone was way ahead of everybody. He was a very great arranger and a piano player. In fact, he was an all-around good musician. I guess he's still living; I think he is.
